content: MV3's enforced minimum CSP for extension_pages is script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self' - only 'self','none','wasm-unsafe-eval' are legal script-src values, generic 'unsafe-eval' is forbidden. Extensions must explicitly declare wasm-unsafe-eval (Chrome will not silently grant it) and this applies identically to service-worker/background pages as to popup/options pages.
